classification: controlled replay of a downloaded public documentation artifact

provider.name: REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

source.transformations: None. Downloaded HTML bytes served directly. Browser serialization has a separate hash. Relative resources were not mirrored.
source.redistribution: Source HTML, full DOM, full accessibility text and proprietary images are not committed.

scenario.mutations: None on vendor service. Temporary local replay server and provider-owned browser only.

raw_tool_output.reason: Full output contains the copyrighted article DOM and accessibility text.

bounded_observations.statement: The downloaded document exposes an article heading, navigation and an article update time through the accessibility capture.
The document contains learner-home sections and links to related official course and catalog documentation.

bounded_observations.class: observed in local HTTP server output
bounded_observations.statement: Relative theme CSS, script and image requests returned 404 because the replay retained the original relative URLs and did not mirror those resources.

failed_prior_attempt.bounded_result: Navigation failed before initial state capture. The exact underlying cause was not exposed. This run is not evidence of live product behavior.

visual_observations.method: Downloaded public screenshot opened with view_image. Not an authenticated runtime capture.

tool_reported_limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.
research_limitations: REA reported no subject/artifact identity. The separately recorded source SHA-256 binds this local input only and does not upgrade the tool authority.
The replay is public documentation, not a signed-in LearnUpon tenant or learner workflow.
Styles, relative scripts and images were not mirrored. No visual equivalence or production accessibility audit is inferred.
No competitor backend, persistence, permission enforcement, performance, offline behavior or unvisited state was verified.
Tool completeness describes the requested local capture, not coverage of the vendor product.
Public screenshots establish visible information only. Interactive behavior remains documented or unknown.
No proprietary screenshot, full help article or full DOM/AX response is redistributed in this repository.

cleanup.local_http_server: Stopped with Ctrl-C after capture. Only the owned research server was stopped.
